application_order: For source reconstruction only, apply directed_test_patch to a scratch CVA6 tree and verify that the generated program matches the distributed harness/hwpf_stride_store_effect.S. The runtime evaluator does not apply this test-source patch.
Start the runtime evaluation from the recorded unpatched revisions and invoke harness/evaluate.sh with the candidate.
The evaluator first checks the external prefetch request sequence and pending-transfer stability at the public ports.
The evaluator applies integration_patch at the CVA6 repository root to pulse configuration for prefetcher zero at 0x80010000 and mark the monitored load snoop as physical.
The evaluator applies submodule_integration_patch inside the pinned HPDcache submodule to compare tag and set-index cache-line numbers.
The evaluator applies request_tag_patch inside the pinned HPDcache submodule to preserve the engine physical tag when the wrapper constructs its cache request.
The shared evaluator integrates the submitted module, then copies the distributed harness/*.S files next to the selected test list into TESTS_PATH/cpu-eval-patches.
The evaluator reverses its three surrounding-CPU integration patches on exit. Do not apply those patches before invocation.

reconstruction.reference_hdl: read rtl/src/hwpf_stride/hwpf_stride.sv from HPDcache submodule f404e7ebbda8baa4af3729535f520a6b12a06d03, which CVA6 revision 6348e9e684678f83b40d0520028513d06b36e7b2 records
reconstruction.test_sources: Reconstruct the 52-line distributed program from directed_test_patch for provenance. During evaluation the shared evaluator copies the distributed assembly into TESTS_PATH/cpu-eval-patches; the test-source patch is not applied at runtime.
reconstruction.evaluation: Start from an unpatched checkout and invoke harness/evaluate.sh with the candidate; the evaluator applies its own patches and restores its inputs.

evaluation_scope.port_scope: Verify the five-address stream and pending request stability at zero throttle. With ready high and Nwait=2, accepted requests are three or four cycles apart (the documented Nwait+1 or the pinned engine's Nwait+2). With delayed acknowledgements and Ninflight=1, at most two accepted requests remain unacknowledged (the pinned engine issues one more before it stalls). A candidate that does not complete each sequence within the cycle bound fails; internal identifiers are ungraded.
evaluation_scope.directed_scope: Complete raw retirement comparison through the stride-arbiter comparator. The three cycle values are diagnostic observations and are not compared with fixed reference cycle counts.
